seo.title: Case Studies & Results
seo.description: How Altarious Global customer acquisition programs deliver results across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

hero.headline: Programs built for outcomes.
hero.subheadline: Illustrative examples of how our inbound call, live transfer and web lead programs are structured for clients. Specific performance data is shared under NDA during the proposal process.

items.title: Regional auto insurance agency scales inbound calls across three states
items.challenge: An independent agency with licensed agents in three states needed a predictable flow of quote-ready drivers during business hours without paying for out-of-footprint traffic.
items.approach: State-restricted call-only search campaigns, IVR qualification for coverage status, and schedule-based routing to the agency's sales line.
items.outcome: A steady, capped daily volume of inbound calls from in-footprint drivers, with source-level reporting the agency used to expand into a fourth state.

items.title: Pest control operator fills the spring schedule with live transfers
items.challenge: A multi-branch pest control company wanted booked-appointment-ready homeowners in its service area during peak season, without tying up dispatchers on unqualified calls.
items.approach: ZIP-targeted campaigns, homeowner and pest-type qualification by our team, and warm transfers to the branch closest to the caller.
items.outcome: Qualified homeowners delivered to the right branch, with dispatch time spent only on consumers who confirmed a service need and property ownership.

items.title: Consumer lender adds inbound calls to a web lead program
items.challenge: A personal loan platform with a strong web lead flow wanted to reach consumers who prefer to talk before applying.
items.approach: Call extensions and click-to-call placements layered onto existing lead campaigns, with duration-based qualification and routing to the lender's loan specialists.
items.outcome: A new inbound call channel running alongside real-time web leads, reported and optimised in the same dashboard.
